intro:
A **45-minute** timed test on the whole of Forces and Newton's Laws — gravity, inertia and the first law, force identification and free-body diagrams, equilibrium, the second law, inclined planes, the third law, and Hooke's law. It is **generated fresh every time you open it**: a new set of questions drawn from across the unit, in a new order, with the answer choices shuffled.

The mix follows the Physics Academy test blueprint (`docs/test-generation.md`). BASIS Physics 8 is a pre-AP course, so items stay within one-dimensional net-force reasoning and simple inclines, but the reasoning is held to AP Physics 1 rigor.

**No calculator.** Every multiple-choice item is built to be solved by hand (the universal-gravitation calculations are held out of the timed test). Multiple choice is scored automatically; free response is scored by you against the model answer and rubric.
